scope: Whether Infinity's DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 endpoint, reached through claude-infinity and omp-infinity, can replace Claude Opus 5.5 for lapis's next-prompt (Tab) guesses and for agent tabs. Model behavior and CLI integration only; no GUI, attention-protocol, long-run or 32-session load qualification.

source.dirty_note: lapis.json was already modified by the operator

tools.baseline: claude-opus-5-5 on a remote Mac, Claude Code 2.1.306
tools.candidate: Infatoshi/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-MXFP4-heretic served by vLLM on 4x B300, 300k context

method.tab_guesses: 55 prompts sampled from the operator's local interactive Claude Code and Codex transcripts since 2026-09-15 (seed 17, 3775 eligible). The system prompt, user turn, parse and metrics are apps/desktop/src/next_prompt.py and scripts/next_prompt_eval.py's replay logic. Each route produced up to three candidates; all nine per prompt were graded blind in one Opus 5.5 call with the existing 0/1/2 rubric. Top-1 sendable means the judge scored the shown guess 2.
method.agent_tasks: Two verified tasks in fresh directories: implement merge_intervals and parse_duration to docstrings, and fix an infinite-loop binary search. Each run was followed by an independent python3 check.py; both printed PASS. Times are wall clock for the whole CLI run, including tool calls.
method.hooks: A PostToolUse and Stop hook wrote to a file while the agent ran one Bash command. Tested through the stock claude-infinity, the stock wrapper with a lapis-style trailing --settings, a merged-settings wrapper, and a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR profile with the endpoint env plus a lapis-style --settings.

tab_guesses.judge: Opus 5.5 graded all routes blind. Its preference for its own phrasing biases against the candidate; the candidate still did not beat it on any prompt in this sample.

hooks.stock_wrapper_with_hooks_from_config_dir: PASS: PostToolUse and Stop fired, 1.3 s
hooks.stock_wrapper_with_lapis_style_settings: FAIL: the trailing --settings replaced the wrapper's apiKeyHelper settings; Claude reported the selected model unavailable
hooks.merged_settings_wrapper_with_lapis_style: PASS: PostToolUse and Stop fired, 1.9 s
hooks.config_dir_endpoint_profile_with_lapis_s: PASS: Stop fired; the Bash call correctly waited for approval in print mode (no PostToolUse without an approval path)

findings: Tab guesses: candidate top-1 sendable 8/55 (14.5%) versus Opus 10/55 (18.2%); the difference is not significant at n=55 (paired 2 versus 0, exact McNemar p=0.5). On action prompts (approve/ship/fix/correct) it is 7/21 versus 8/21 sendable and 13/21 versus 12/21 intent.

Every sendable candidate guess was also sendable for Opus; the candidate added no unique wins. The misses are near-misses on long, new instructions, where the candidate tends to over-specify or answer a related question.

Latency: candidate median 3.0 to 3.3 s, Opus 4.2 s (p90 4.1 to 4.3 s versus 5.4 s) on the same prompts. The Opus baseline ran over ssh on a remote Mac because this Mac's own Claude OAuth session was expired; local Opus calls on a 25k-character prompt took up to 194 s on the available local account.
Agent tasks: both candidate clients solved both tasks and passed independent verification; 2.6 to 4.6 s versus 8.4 to 20.8 s for Opus. One task pair is not a broad coding-quality claim.

Agent attention: Claude hooks fire on the DeepSeek backend. The stock claude-infinity cannot be used unchanged in a lapis Claude tab because lapis's hook adapter passes its own --settings, which replaces the wrapper's endpoint auth; a 20-line merge fixes it and was verified.

The wrapper hardcodes --permission-mode bypassPermissions, so a tab using it never raises a permission request. lapis resolves the Claude harness by the command name claude, so the wrapper also needs an absolute-path shim rather than replacing claude on PATH (the wrapper itself execs claude).
omp is a lapis terminal-adapter harness, not a Claude hook adapter. It runs and edits correctly, but Claude's request/finished-turn attention protocol does not apply.
not_run: The live lapis desktop with these clients, including Tab presentation, Ultra Tab cards and native input.
Attention delivery through the real session service with the DeepSeek backend.
Long-running or heavy multi-file agent work, memory, and 8/32-session workload.
Ultra Tab composed-card quality under the endpoint; only the next-prompt path was measured.
A local Opus 5.5 baseline under the Mac's own plan (OAuth expired during the test).
